id.description: Stable slug, never renamed once assigned -- same convention as a GPU's id.

name.description: Display name. canitrunlocal upserts its Runtime rows by this exact string, so renaming it here creates a new row there rather than updating the existing one.

version.description: The version canitrunlocal reports as currently tracked. Bump on a release worth noting, not on every patch.

github.description: Canonical source repo -- linked from canitrunlocal's UI wherever this runtime is shown.
